solutions.title: Sliding window / KMP-ready scan
solutions.description:
**Approach:** Slide `needle` over `haystack` (or implement KMP for optimal worst-case).

**Why preferred:** Shows you can implement search without leaning on library helpers — useful interview signal.

**Example walkthrough:** Slide a window of length `3` over `"sadbutsad"`. The slice at `0` equals `"sad"`, so return `0`.
solutions.time: O(n · m) naive / O(n + m) KMP

solutions.title: Built-in indexOf
solutions.notes: String.indexOf — valid LC, weak interview answer
solutions.description:
**Approach:** Return `haystack.indexOf(needle)`.

**vs recommended:** Perfectly fine on LeetCode Easy. In interviews, be ready to write the nested scan (and mention KMP if asked about worst case).

**Example walkthrough:** Delegate to `haystack.indexOf("sad")`, which returns `0`.
